notes: Read SKILL.md (505 lines) in full; it is the only file in source. Guidance and C# samples for the Azure Maps .NET SDKs: geocoding, reverse geocoding, boundary polygons, routing, route matrix/range, map tiles, IP geolocation, and weather.

Tells the agent to run `dotnet add package ... --prerelease` for several official Azure Maps packages and Azure.Identity (SKILL.md:20-38) and to authenticate with a subscription key from AZURE_MAPS_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY, DefaultAzureCredential, or an ARM-generated SAS token (SKILL.md:64-119); one sample saves a fetched tile to ./MapTile.png (SKILL.md:358). The agent itself does not handle real secrets: credential and service calls live in sample code for the user's application. Medium for package installs (unpinned preview versions) and live-credential use; acceptable because the packages are official, the calls are read-style location queries, and credentials stay within the user's own app.

The 'copyright' signals at SKILL.md:144 and 231 are SDK API names (GetCopyrightCaption, boundary Copyright property), not rights notices on the skill text. Several packages are preview (beta) versions. Calls are billable Azure Maps transactions; see the Pricing link (SKILL.md:505).
